hold_text: Touches scripts/ops/desk_scan_packet.py (the desk's scan-packet generator, read path; not loaded by the trader per trader_import_closure decide=SKIP); the manager merges.
why: WHY: desk scan packet DP-20261119T2011Z-scan-1h (desk/decisions commit c7221e28eb, built 20:14:58Z) reported system_book {items: [], read_state: read}, and the desk wake is proposing on that packet. The book was not empty: the 16:10Z packet listed 24 open packages, live_review_due at 20:02Z counted 23, and the 7 alpaca_portfolio SLV packages got live-review packets at 20:01-20:07Z. The build fell inside a diag outage window (my own /api/diag/live_review_due reads timed out at 20:09-20:12Z and the proxy tunnel dropped). Root cause: live_review_packet.collect() records failed reads in Snapshot.errors instead of raising, and desk_scan_packet.system_book_from_snapshot() ignored them, so a blind read became an empty book reported as read. This is the collapsed-state class (CLAUDE.md: a count that reads 0 may mean 'we could not look'). WHAT: system_book_read_errors() names any failed open-set source that open_package_ids unions (telemetry, prop_tickets, order_packages@0, trades@0). Any failure makes the system book could_not_look (items null), with the failed reads named in meta.missing_inputs; unrelated failures (news, prop_status) do not. Self-test: 4 new cases plus the existing ones PASS (the summary line was moved after them so they count toward the exit code). tests/test_desk_scan_packet.py and tests/test_desk_scan_1h_horizon.py: 7 passed. ruff (E4,E7,E9,F) clean. Gates this adds or changes: none.
